birth.place: Munzingen, Freiburg im Breisgau, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

summary: John's 5th great-grandmother; of the Munzingen Federer family (not the Ibental Fürderer).
bio: M. Anna Federer 'von hier' (of Munzingen) married the gamekeeper Joseph Heizler in 1799; mother of Friedrich (1809) and Agatha (1813). She is alive (not marked deceased) as 'Anna Federer' in the 1835 marriage. Johann Federer, former glazier then farmer, who witnessed her daughter Veronica's 1815 burial and the 1836 marriage, was probably her brother or father, and may be where Servatius learned glazing (speculative). Earlier research had guessed 'Federer' = the Unteribental farm family Fürderer/Förderer (Peterhof; entries 1646–1785; GEDBAS 1444211359 'Fürderer (Förderer)') — now disproven. GEDBAS has no Federer in Munzingen. Tree: Maria Anna Federer 1772–1844, parents Georgius G Federer 1732–1802 and Maria Anna Kaltenbach 1745–1808.
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1590 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, civil-register duplicates/Standesbücher 1810–1839; 549 images; record id 5-480946), marriages 1835 http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480946-450 ; 1836 http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480946-464
